official_title: An Act for laying a Duty on Goods, Wares, and Merchandises imported into the United States
core_mechanism: Initial specific and ad valorem import duties; drawback on qualifying re-export; vessel-based discount
observation_fields: commodity; origin; vessel status; quantity; customs value; rate; duty assessed; export date; drawback
notes: Preserve scheduled rates by section; one-percent retention applied to qualifying drawback under the act

official_title: An Act imposing Duties on Tonnage
core_mechanism: Different tonnage rates by vessel construction and ownership; coastwise treatment
observation_fields: vessel; registry; ownership; tonnage; voyage type; duty assessed

official_title: An Act to regulate the Collection of the Duties imposed by law on the tonnage of ships or vessels, and on goods, wares and merchandises imported into the United States
core_mechanism: Established customs districts, ports, officers, entry procedures, valuation, security, and enforcement
observation_fields: district; port; officer; entry date; manifest; invoice; valuation; bond; payment; penalty
notes: Implementation evidence must come from customhouse records, not the statute alone

official_title: An Act imposing Duties on the Tonnage of Ships or Vessels
core_mechanism: Revised tonnage regime and repealed the 1789 act prospectively
observation_fields: vessel; registry; ownership; tonnage; voyage type; duty assessed
notes: Accrued duties under the earlier act remained collectible

official_title: An Act to provide more effectually for the collection of the duties imposed by law on goods, wares and merchandise imported into the United States, and on the tonnage of ships or vessels
core_mechanism: Replaced and expanded customs collection rules, including entry, security, valuation, and enforcement
observation_fields: district; entry; manifest; valuation; duty; credit term; bond; surety; maturity; cash payment; default
notes: Section-level extraction required before transaction coding

official_title: An Act making further provision for the payment of the debts of the United States
core_mechanism: Revised import duties and linked revenue to funded-debt provision
observation_fields: commodity; quantity; value; rate; duty assessed; duty secured; revenue fund; appropriation
notes: Do not combine statutory pledge with observed cash availability

official_title: An Act supplementary to the act intituled An act making further provision for the payment of the debts of the United States
core_mechanism: Changed duties on selected imported articles and related provisions
observation_fields: commodity; quantity; value; old rate; new rate; effective date; duty assessed
notes: Full section and effective-date transcription remains required

official_title: An Act for raising a farther sum of Money for the Protection of the Frontiers, and for other Purposes therein mentioned
core_mechanism: Raised or altered selected import duties and amended collection treatment
observation_fields: commodity; quantity; value; rate; credit term; drawback rule; duty assessed
notes: Separate revenue purpose from realized collection

official_title: An Act laying additional Duties on Goods, Wares and Merchandise imported into the United States
core_mechanism: Added duties to selected imports; foreign-vessel addition; allowed qualifying re-export drawback less retention
observation_fields: commodity; vessel status; quantity; value; additional rate; duty; re-export date; drawback; retention
notes: Act states a twelve-month re-export window and one-percent retention

official_title: An Act further extending the time for receiving on Loan the Domestic Debt of the United States
core_mechanism: Contains import-duty provisions identified by the Statutes at Large index; exact operative sections require transcription
observation_fields: commodity; rate; effective date; duty assessed; statutory section
notes: Title alone obscures the customs provision; do not code rates until sections are checked

official_title: An Act for raising a further Sum of Money by additional Duties on certain Articles imported; and for other Purposes
core_mechanism: Added import duties on selected articles
observation_fields: commodity; quantity; value; additional rate; effective date; duty assessed
notes: Exact rate schedule requires section transcription

official_title: An Act laying an additional Duty on Salt imported into the United States, and for other Purposes
core_mechanism: Additional salt duty with linked provisions affecting fisheries and salted provisions
observation_fields: salt quantity; duty; vessel; fish or provision export; allowance; payment
notes: Continued by the act of May 7, 1800

official_title: An Act to regulate the collection of duties on imports and tonnage
core_mechanism: Comprehensive collection code covering districts, officers, manifests, entry, valuation, bonds, payment, drawbacks, enforcement, and debentures
observation_fields: all customs_law and customs_obligation fields; original import line; re-export event; drawback claim and payment
notes: This is the controlling implementation baseline for the endpoint period; sections must be mapped individually

official_title: An Act to continue in force An act laying an additional duty on Salt imported into the United States, and for other purposes
core_mechanism: Continued the 1797 salt-duty act for ten years from March 3, 1800, subject to stated duration
observation_fields: commodity; rate; effective period; statutory predecessor
notes: Treat as continuation, not a new observed rate without checking the 1797 schedule

official_title: An Act to retain a further sum on drawbacks, for the expenses incident to the allowance and payment thereof, and in lieu of stamp duties on debentures
core_mechanism: Increased retained share of drawbacks and denied drawback of the foreign-vessel additional duty
observation_fields: drawback allowed; retention rate; vessel status; debenture; net drawback paid
notes: Critical for measuring net rather than gross drawback

official_title: An Act to lay additional duties on certain articles imported
core_mechanism: Added duties including sugar and molasses; revised wine duties; appropriated proceeds to federal debt
observation_fields: commodity; quantity; value; old rate; additional rate; vessel status; duty; drawback; revenue appropriation
notes: Statutory appropriation does not establish amount or timing of cash collected

official_title: An Act concerning the mode of discharging certain cargoes in the District of Massachusetts
core_mechanism: Allowed specified salt-cargo discharge under customs inspection with timing and clearance conditions
observation_fields: district; cargo; entry; security; landing place; inspector; discharge days; fee; clearance

official_title: An Act concerning certain unregistered ships or vessels
core_mechanism: Limited application of the 1800 drawback rule for qualifying citizen-owned unregistered vessels
observation_fields: vessel registration; ownership; sea letter; import date; drawback treatment; Treasury certificate

official_title: An Act to amend An act to establish the compensations of the officers employed in the collection of the duties on imports and tonnage; and for other purposes
core_mechanism: Changed specified collector compensation and capped net officer emoluments with surplus payable to Treasury
observation_fields: district; officer; gross emoluments; office expense; cap; surplus paid
notes: Administrative cost and remittance evidence; not a tariff-rate change
